caption:
what does PA++++ mean on Korean sunscreen?

PA is the UVA grade on Korean sunscreen. It comes from a lab number called PFA:
PA+ = 2 to under 4
PA++ = 4 to under 8
PA+++ = 8 to under 16
PA++++ = 16 or more

SPF is mostly about sunburn. PA is about UVA. Korea added the PA++++ grade in 2016.

Send this to the friend who only checks the SPF.

Source: Korea Ministry of Food and Drug Safety press release, Sep 8, 2016.
